metadata.scope: Both mechanisms on the Return entity: buyer self-service (VCST-5628), agent decisions and notifications (VCST-5883), legacy admin records. Orderless returns (VCST-5884) and the mandatory decline reason (VCST-5885) are out.
metadata.built_from: returns.md rev 1 (§1 value chain, §2, §3 D1-D9, §5), test model VCST-5883-2026-09-28 (Part 0, scenarios), suites 050o, 014c, 073, 073a, 073b (Title + References + status), run REG-2026-10-01-2133, kb entries below. No BL-RET / ECL returns oracle exists, so no oracle_refs.
metadata.kb_read: 2026-10-06 — 4 questions (authorize outcome, returnableItems eligibility, available-statuses / cancel, notifications); opened KB-21F4F161, KB-F97CFAF6, KB-17555498, KB-06CFE625; cited from headlines KB-700E5D52, KB-DF9F415E, KB-4E1FF232, KB-C6BB1914, KB-1F2EBF83, KB-85F02FDB
metadata.domain_map_note: returns.md rev 1 predates both deployments: its §2b 'storefront not reachable' and 'agent approve/reject UNVERIFIED' are out of date — refresh it with /qa-domain-map returns.
metadata.evidence_note: Promoted cases record a promoting ticket and date, not a run id, so they are cited as {SPEC}; {OBSERVED} comes from kb entries, REG-2026-10-01-2133 and the domain map's live pass.
